title.narrative: Support to the Government of the Republic of Moldova in its formulation and effective implementation of the national industrial development programme and policy through institutional capacity building

description.narrative: Over the past years, the Government of the Republic of Moldova has undertaken measures to improve the overall competitiveness of the economy, increasing industrial productivity, stimulating entrepreneurship, encouraging knowledge and innovation transfer through capacity development and adoption of international standards and best practices within the overarching goal of full integration into EU markets and global value chains. In June 2022, the Republic of Moldova received the EU candidate status, which marked a significant milestone towards the strengthened integration with the EU markets and processes. The imperative towards EU integration is further reinforced in the National Development Strategy (NDS) # European Moldova 2030 # endorsed in November 2022. Taking into consideration the current multifaceted challenges including those related to energy, food, value and supply chains causing notable economic distress, in particular, in the areas of energy security, regional logistics and economic competitiveness, there is a pressing need for a comprehensive industrial policy to accelerate digitalization and speeding up the greening of the industrial sector.
